candidates.title: Site Engineer - Urban Development - EOI 2027
candidates.abstract: Seeking hands-on Site Engineer to develop a career in the Water Infrastructure Industry.
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you hold a Construction Induction Safety certificate (White Card)?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
candidates.content_text:
Build projects, solve problems and be part of the delivery
Jaydo is a Victorian civil construction contractor delivering water, sewerage, drainage and related infrastructure works across Victoria.
Our Urban Development team delivers civil infrastructure across subdivisions, council projects and associated development works. We are looking for a Site Engineer who wants to be close to the action and play a key role in getting projects delivered safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
This is a hands-on role for an engineer who enjoys being on site, working alongside Supervisors and crews, solving problems and seeing the results of their work on the ground.
About the role
As a Site Engineer within our Urban Development team, you will work closely with Project Managers, Supervisors, subcontractors and site crews to coordinate the day-to-day delivery of civil works.
You will be involved across planning, engineering, procurement, quality, cost control and site coordination, with the opportunity to take increasing ownership of project outcomes as you develop.
What you'll be doing
- Coordinating day-to-day engineering and site requirements
- Reviewing drawings, specifications and project requirements
- Working closely with Supervisors and construction crews to keep works moving
- Planning upcoming works, materials, subcontractors and resources
- Managing RFIs and resolving technical and constructability issues
- Completing ITPs, quality records and project documentation
- Monitoring quantities, costs, progress and productivity
- Assisting with procurement and subcontractor management
- Supporting safety and environmental requirements
- Liaising with clients, consultants, suppliers and other project stakeholders
- Identifying issues early and working with the team to find practical solutions
About you
You'll ideally have:
- A degree in Civil Engineering or a related discipline
- Experience in civil construction, ideally across drainage, sewer, water, subdivisions or council infrastructure
- A practical understanding of how civil projects are built
- Confidence working between the site and project team
- Strong organisation and communication skills
- The ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications
- A willingness to take ownership and follow things through
- A practical, solutions-focused approach
You don't need to know everything from day one. We're looking for someone with a solid engineering foundation, the right attitude and a genuine interest in becoming a strong civil construction professional.
Why Jaydo?
At Jaydo, you won't be sitting on the sidelines.
You'll work alongside experienced Project Managers, Engineers, Supervisors and construction teams and have the opportunity to build genuine project delivery experience.
We offer:
- Hands-on involvement in real civil construction projects
- Exposure across drainage, sewer, water, subdivision and council infrastructure
- Strong support from experienced construction and project leaders
- Opportunities to develop both your technical and commercial capability
- A practical working environment where engineers are encouraged to get involved
- Career progression within our Urban Development team
- The opportunity to build a long-term career with an established Victorian civil contractor
If you're a civil engineer who wants to be on site, take ownership and build your career through real project delivery, we'd like to hear from you.
Interested?
To learn more about Jaydo Construction and the projects we deliver, please visit www.jaydo.com.au
Or our Linkedin page https://www.linkedin.com/company/jaydo-constructions/mycompany/
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women, culturally and linguistically diverse candidates are less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Jaydo we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every aspect of the position we encourage you to apply anyways as you may be just the right candidate.
**Only Shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
